budget.interpretation: report pilot ceilings and adjudication costs separately. Statistical precision depends on the number of genuinely independent outcomes

candidates.accounting: log all projection queries, selected offers, installed tasks, accepted routes, rejections and fallbacks
candidates.duplicates: collapse identical projected options without resampling
candidates.generator: one frozen local proposer across methods, with its original offer and one optional private extra draw
candidates.projection: original onboard projection using the local map
candidates.sampling: use the private original_offer stream with frozen NeighborPolicy.propose for the shared single-offer comparator. Draw the optional alternative on extra_offer independently of the reference and continuation streams
candidates.standby: scene.initial_executor_wait_point, given only to the executor and fixed across paired arms

study.continuation_freeze: pin implementations and weights of both prospective policies before collecting formal arms. The terminal-mode identifier becomes available only after first receipt

continuations.handoff_value: rank by a frozen local handoff-value rule derived only on development families with grid terminal control
continuations.local_coverage: rank feasible proposals by new local search coverage

study.historical_use: reserve previously used physical families in development while retaining the original split and outcome restrictions of each archive

holdout.inheritance: every branch and continuation repeat inherits its departure family across arms and replicate seeds
holdout.release: after the local rules, predictions, study tolerances and analysis version are frozen

problem.decision: one simultaneous departure of the eligible search boats
problem.deployment: one deterministic rule per boat using its role, own history, local offers and previously delivered messages
problem.primary_outcome: native terminal mission success with censoring at external observation caps
problem.reference: best jointly admissible departure assignment conditional on the pooled predecision histories and offers, under the same frozen continuation
problem.scope: declared family support, with group-mean claims when only group means are estimable
problem.secondary_outcome: one original team reward per physical interval, discounted with gamma 0.95

random_streams.derivation: first 64 bits of SHA-256 of canonical JSON [master_seed, family_id, stream, boat, repeat], unsigned big-endian
random_streams.pairing: offer repeat is zero. Pair continuation streams by repeat across assignments and terminal modes using arm-independent keys
random_streams.scene_innovations: native scenario_seed and planner_seed from the original manifest

terminal_modes.direct: existing direct final leg, eligible only after actual first packet receipt

tolerance.verdict: certify only when a simultaneous upper bound on loss is within tolerance. Overlapping intervals or unsupported families remain unresolved
